'''Chief Foreman''' was a title held by an [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] worker who, along with other Ugnaughts, was forced to work for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] in the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] facility inside one of the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] in the [[Valsedian asteroid belt|Valsedian belt]]. During the [[Mission to the Valsedian asteroid belt|Valsedian operation]], he and the other workers were taken prisoners under an [[Deflector shield/Legends|energy shield]] by the pirates guarding the facility. They were rescued by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Tyzen Xebec]], who fought the pirates, and by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who destroyed the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]].
